description: This file provides utility methods for byte manipulation, conversion, and search within byte arrays, mainly used for parsing and processing binary data in the RomRaider project.
external_methods: ByteBuffer.wrap(byte[] array, int offset, int length)

classes.name: ByteUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various byte operations such as conversions between bytes, int, float, and search within byte arrays.

methods.name: asUnsignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte to its unsigned integer representation.

methods.name: asSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a signed integer.

methods.name: asByte
methods.description: Converts an integer to a byte.

methods.name: asFloat
methods.description: Converts a subset of a byte array (from offset, with specified length) to a float.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Converts a byte to an integer.

methods.name: matchOnes
methods.description: Checks if specific bits (mask) are set to 1 in a byte.

methods.name: matchZeroes
methods.description: Checks if specific bits (mask) are zero in a byte.

methods.name: byteListToBytes
methods.description: Copies a list of Byte objects into a byte array.

methods.name: indexOfBytes
methods.description: Searches for a pattern byte array within another byte array and returns the index of the first match, or -1 if not found.
